knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The guide calls for a surgical mask and eye protection, then a gown and gloves, before the clean begins. The other options skip protection or the order of work.
A two-in-one clean combines the detergent and disinfectant in one product. The first option describes the two-step method instead.
The guide sequence moves from mopping to removing the protective items, hand hygiene and fresh gloves, then equipment cleaning. The other options break that order.

practicalCriteria: In a simulated room, the learner completes the terminal clean steps in the stated order, with protective items on at entry and hand hygiene at the end.
The learner names the products used from the facility list and states whether the method is a two-step or two-in-one clean.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation of the simulated terminal clean
Completed terminal clean record for the simulation
stopWorkCriteria: The clinical team has not released the room: stop and do not begin the clean.
The product label or the facility list does not permit the product: stop and ask the supervisor.
Fumes or a skin reaction occurs during the clean: stop, ventilate if the product allows, and report.
